svg.title: Babul-da pedals the evidence and Cecil away from the Old Exchange.
svg.desc: The cycle van accelerates through the wet lane. Cecil braces the folders on the cargo bed, Riju runs beside the waterproof tube, and Babul-da rings once as the battery-lit Exchange falls behind.
svg.text: Page 51, panel 3 · Low tracking shot as the cycle van leaves the Old Exchange
